result.topic_en: Series expansions of the complete elliptic integrals E and F (as functions of the modulus), the differential relations between them, a Legendre-type relation for F, f and their derivatives in terms of an angle φ, and the connection of F with the arithmetic-geometric mean M(1+x,1−x).
